note: Generated by art/slice_decor.py. Paths are relative to this file. All sprites share one downscale factor (sourceScale) so sizes are comparable within a sheet. anchor = normalized point in the sprite that sits on the room position: floor/surface = x: middle of the lowest third of the solid pixels, y: lowest solid row (floor contact), rug = centre, wall = centre or, for hanging items, top centre. footprint = [x0, x1] of that contact band in sprite px (use its width for depth sorting; rugs draw under everything). defaultScale = multiplier for a 1536x1024 room at 280 px per metre.
